mechanism: Gentamicin (aminoglycoside) has ototoxic and nephrotoxic potential; brivaracetam undergoes renal excretion, and renal impairment from gentamicin could alter brivaracetam clearance and increase CNS side effects.
action: Monitor renal function, serum gentamicin levels, and brivaracetam efficacy/tolerability; adjust brivaracetam dose if renal function declines; assess for ototoxicity and dizziness.
